data.name: Abys Orbit
data.detailed_description:
The galaxy is under fire — and it needs a pilot like you!

AbysOrbit is a FREE, real-time multiplayer space combat MMO you can play directly in your browser. No download, no installation — jump into a vast universe with a single click. Join one of three powerful factions, turn an ordinary ship into a legend, and fight shoulder to shoulder (or head to head) with thousands of pilots on the same map.

Key Features

  • Real-Time PvP & PvE — Hunt enemy pilots and NPC fleets in instant laser/rocket duels.

  • 3 Factions, One Galaxy — NTO, SPX, or BOF; pick your side, defend your borders, raid rival territories.

  • Upgrade Your Ships — Endless progression with CPUs, drones, configurations, and refining.

  • Clans & Diplomacy — Found your clan, forge alliances, climb to the top of the clan rankings.

  • Auction & Trade — Enter sealed-bid bidding wars for rare ships, drones, and equipment.

  • ApexGate — Build the gates, face deadly waves, and claim the big rewards.

  • 100+ Missions & Rank System — Rise as you progress, prove your title and your power.

  • Premium & Starter Pack — Start with an edge, level up faster.

  • 15 Language Support — Play on Windows.

Join Now!

The universe expands every day, and the most valuable territories are being claimed fast. Don't miss the exclusive starter perks for early pilots — get into the cockpit, pull the trigger, and write your name among the galaxy's legends. Victory belongs to the bold!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz dual-core) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with WebGL 2.0 support (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX sound card
  • Additional Notes: Free-to-play online space MMO. A stable broadband internet connection is required for online play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (3.0 GHz quad-core) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete graphics card (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or higher) or modern integrated (Intel Iris Xe)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX sound card
  • Additional Notes: A constant broadband internet connection is required for online gameplay.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 (dual-core 2.4 GHz)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGL 2.0 capable GPU (Apple M1 integrated / Intel Iris Graphics)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Free-to-play online space MMO. A stable broadband internet connection is required for online play.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 or Intel Core i5 (quad-core 3.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU or a modern dedicated/integrated GPU with WebGL 2.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Requires a stable broadband Internet connection for online play.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent (dual-core 2.4 GHz); Steam Deck APU supported
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGL 2.0 capable GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD equivalent)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Free-to-play online space MMO. A stable broadband internet connection is required. Playable on Steam Deck.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (quad-core 3.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560) or modern integrated with WebGL 2.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a stable broadband Internet connection. Playable on Steam Deck.
